verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a self-serve 30-day free trial and generic pipeline and opportunity management features. Nothing documents a data import or migration path, guided setup, or a time-to-working-pipeline that would let a founder load real data in under an hour without a partner. Community comments about needing customizations and consultants are general sentiment, not a concrete onboarding failure, so they do not create a dispute.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner
